note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type NUMBERS/results. Primary read in full: Nintendo's 5 Nov 2026 earnings documents (nintendo.co.jp/ir/pdf/2026/261105e.pdf highlights, 261105_3e.pdf explanatory material, 261105_2e.pdf dividend notice), six months to 30 Sep 2026 vs the year before: net sales 966.0 bn yen (down 12.1%), operating profit 216.5 bn yen (up 49.1%), ordinary 300.6 bn, net profit 220.9 bn (up 11.0%); Switch 2 hardware sell-in 6.49 M units (down 37.4%; Q1 3.82 M, Q2 2.67 M) and software 24.49 M (up 18.8%); full-year forecast unchanged from 8 May (net sales 2,050 bn, operating profit 370 bn, Switch 2 hardware 16.50 M, software 60.00 M); interim dividend 76 yen vs 42 (annual forecast 162 unchanged); about 300 M USD tariff refund credit recorded as a reduction of cost of sales (not on screen). Hook: profit up almost half while sales fall. Picture: official Splatoon Raiders store art (1920x1080) closing, cards on the gold living ground (company results, no footage worth enlarging; Nintendo store videos are 720p).
